'''Matt Passion''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Huntsville tournament (17 February)]] on 17 February 2001 with [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|CCT with Jabba's Prize]], according to Andy McClure's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1754">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-20-huntsville-al-02-17-01d1754/ huntsville-al-02-17-01], DeckTech (Andy "Solo337" McClure, 20 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-20-huntsville-al-02-17-01d1754/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
